annotations.title: Company change history (pricing, terms, privacy, subprocessors)

description: Did they raise prices or change their terms? What changed on a company's pricing, terms of service, privacy policy and subprocessor pages, and when. Returns the change history (prices added/removed, free plan or trial added/removed, subprocessors added/removed, text added/removed) and the current prices. Stormap checks tracked pages about once a day; asking about a new company starts tracking it, so history builds from that day. Useful for competitor monitoring, vendor renewals and compliance.

since_days.description: Only return changes from the last N days.
